title: "After the day"
aliases:
  - /tracks/one-day-methods/after.html
---
The methods strand of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) takes each model and each argument of the day further.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| Every model of the course on the panel, output by output: the linear model, clustered errors, fixed effects, within and between, bounded outcomes and the common scale | [The statistical methods behind the course](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd) |
| The graph work at a slower pace, and a graph for a question of your own | [Causal graphs](../../companion/dags.qmd) |
| The measurement decisions that the menu opened | [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd), [Missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) and [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd) |
| The multiverse debate in full, with its critics read against the curve of the claim | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |
| Data generated from known values, to test what a method recovers | [Simulation as a method](../../companion/simulation.qmd) |
| The claim at the level of the respondents, which the day leaves to the three-day course | [The individual level](../../companion/individual-level.qmd) |
| To archive and version the analysis that you declared | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |

The other formats of the course take the same case in other directions: the [open-science day](../eu-frames-one-day-open-science/index.qmd) gives the time of this day to the practices of open research and to replication, the [data-tools day](../eu-frames-one-day-data-tools/index.qmd) gives it to R, the IDE, data management and version control, and the [three-day course](../eu-frames-three-days/index.qmd) builds the data from the raw survey files and reproduces all five analysts.
